story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by sages and fools. Sages always tell the truth, and fools always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Ethan, and Noah. In a statement by Ethan: "Noah is a fool and Noah is a sage". Noah was heard saying, "if Ethan is a sage then Ethan is a fool". So who is a sage and who is a fool? (Format your answer like: "Ethan is a sage/fool, and Noah is a sage/fool")

options: Ethan is a sage, Noah is a fool
Ethan is a fool, Noah is a sage
Ethan is a sage, Noah is a sage
Ethan is a fool, Noah is a fool
